entities.name: Azor
aliases: Last Guardian of the Immortal Sun
entities.description: A sphinx of unknown origin and former planeswalker, a lawmage and hieromancer who authored the Guildpact and created the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who conquered one of Azor's client worlds; Azor and Ugin planned to trap him.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker and Azor's ally who helped devise the plan to get rid of Bolas.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A powerful artifact created by Azor on Ixalan that prevented planeswalkers from leaving the plane.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Azor sacrificed his spark and became the Last Guardian.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Azor is remembered as First Judge Azorius and parun of the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The place on Ixalan where Azor kept the Immortal Sun in his sanctum.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who, as the Living Guildpact, sentenced Azor to solitude.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to kill Azor.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The inter-guild pact of Ravnica, largely written by Azor.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: The island where Azor was sentenced to spend his life in solitude.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: A character who fought alongside Azor in the defense of Ixalan.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion of Ixalan in which Azor fought.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Beings on Ixalan whom Azor considered the wisest on the plane.

events.summary: Azor and Ugin meet at the Palace of Justice and devise a plan to get rid of Bolas.
events.quote: Together, they devised a plan to get rid of Bolas for good.

events.summary: Azor travels to Ixalan and sacrifices his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there too.
events.quote: By this act, he also trapped himself on the plane.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska reach Azor in his sanctum in Orazca; he reveals he never received Ugin's signal.
events.quote: but that he had never received Ugin's signal to activate the sun and draw the evil dragon to the plane.

events.summary: Jace stops Vraska from killing Azor and, as the Living Guildpact, sentences him to solitude on Useless Island.
Azor fights alongside Elenda of Garrano defending Ixalan.
events.quote: Azor fought alongside Elenda of Garrano in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.quote: which caused him and his fellow planeswalker and ally Ugin to search for a way to defeat the elder dragon.

relations.note: sacrificed his spark to create it
relations.quote: sacrificed his planeswalker's spark to create the Immortal Sun

relations.note: built the Sun to imprison Bolas
relations.quote: It was revealed that he had created the Immortal Sun to imprison Nicol Bolas
Vraska tried to kill him for disrupting the balance of countless planes
